title: Malicious code in ep_nxs75183 (npm)
description: The Etherpad plugin ep_nxs75183 (version 1.0.0) contains malicious code that registers an undocumented, unauthenticated HTTP GET route '/Nx_75183/'. This endpoint responds with an HTML page revealing sensitive host information such as hostname, user name, platform, Node.js version, current working directory, and process ID. The plugin does not provide legitimate functionality and exposes the server to remote visitors without authentication, effectively marking the server as compromised.
